3c14d2f15db7aced.description: تعلن الشركة عن حاجتها إلى مهندس موقع مدني للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، على أن يكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف المباشر على الأعمال التنفيذية بالموقع وضمان تنفيذ الأعمال وفق المخططات والمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة، لديه خبرة كافية في العظم والتشطيب , (((دقيق الملاحظة ولديه اهتمام في تفاصيل التشطيب وتنفيذها بشكل احترافي)))) ,مع متابعة جودة التنفيذ وسلامة الموقع والتنسيق بين الفرق المختلفة لتحقيق أهداف المشروع ضمن الجدول الزمني المحدد.

3c90f3b67c88f75d.description: As a Housekeeping Supervisor you are responsible for supervising the daily operation as well as the Room Attendants to ensure standards are followed and cleanliness in all related areas is maintained. General Duties and Responsibilities: · Prepare and delegate daily tasks to Housekeeping Attendants and provide Houskeeping Attendants with necessary resources such as keys and supplies to ensure efficient service on the floors · Handle Guest requests and complaints with care and follow up effectively to enhance Guest satisfaction · Inspect Guest rooms to ensure cleanliness and compliance to the Leading Quality Assurance standards of the Hotel · Monitor room status i.e VIP/DND etc and effectively communicate room status and release rooms to the Front Office Department to maintain a efficient operation · Report damaged items in the room and broken equipment to the Engineering Department as well as any lost and found items by following the set procedures · Order Housekeeping supplies on time and ensure inventory procedures are followed to maintain sufficient stock levels for the operational demands · Evaluate Housekeeping Attendant performance throughout the year and provide effective feedback when needed. Report any performance issues to the Assistant Housekeeper/ Assistant Director of Housekeeping · Train Room Attendants on Standards of Performance (SOPs) to maintain the desired level of performance and Leading Quality Assurance standards You should ideally have a diploma or vocational training hospitality with previous minor supervisory experiences within the Housekeeping Department of a hotel. Good command of written and spoken English communication skills, along with strong interpersonal and problem solving abilities are essentials. Computer literacy and previous experiences with Opera are an advantage

3c4394e521b247a0.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Bellstand Supervisor to join our team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for overseeing bellstand operations and ensuring exceptional guest service. The role involves direct guest interaction, luggage assistance, and supporting the management team in various departmental functions. Key Responsibilities Greet guests, provide information on property amenities, services, hours of operation, and local attractions. Open doors and assist guests/visitors entering and leaving the property. Manage luggage storage and retrieval, and transport guest luggage to and from rooms or designated areas. Assist guests/visitors with vehicle entry and exit, including loading and unloading luggage. Provide directions and arrange transportation (*, taxi, shuttle, limousine) for guests, recording advance requests. Dispatch bell staff or valet staff as needed and communicate parking procedures to guests. Follow up with guests to ensure satisfaction with requests or problem resolution. Serve as a departmental role model and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Operational Duties and Standards Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate using clear and professional language, and answer telephones with appropriate etiquette. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats (*, small print). Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Ability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to perform the physical requirements of the position. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. The Bellstand Supervisor will work within a dynamic hospitality environment, directly interacting with guests and supporting a dedicated team.

3c1a4b41e7e2809e.description: About the Role KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking an Instrument Technician II to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the reliability and availability of instrument assets, which are essential for maintaining the operational status of process units. The position requires 4-6 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate the activities of the maintenance technician team, ensuring compliance with preventive maintenance plans and efficient execution of breakdown maintenance on Instrument systems, equipment, and facilities. Execute monthly and weekly maintenance plans, control progress, and submit regular reports. Provide onsite maintenance and repairs for various types of instruments, including generators, transformers, and motors. Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to established standards, specifications, safety procedures, manufacturer’s recommendations, and contract terms. Act as the focal point for the daily Instrument maintenance execution plan. Conduct frequent site visits to monitor work execution and oversee technicians involved in routine maintenance. Track Instrument maintenance work progress and provide regular reports with recommendations to the Instrument foreman. Maintain records of daily maintenance tasks against planned programs and prepare work completion reports as required. Assist in implementing engineering modifications and enhancements to Instrument equipment by recommending improvements to increase the suitability and serviceability of Instrument systems. Required Qualifications and Skills Demonstrated proactive safety aptitude and behavior. Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Instrument systems. Good knowledge of Instrument equipment design, installation, and maintenance. Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro-hydraulic systems. Strong understanding of standards, procedures, and regulations related to Health, Safety, and Environmental preservation. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good command of both oral and written English.

3cbc52fdb22fef2a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال ذي الصلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

3c52f9fdf7eabb5a.description: About the Role Ericsson is establishing a new Request for Change function within Managed Services. This function will focus on driving technical governance, solution design, and change architecture across Core Network domains. The Core Technical Lead will play a central role in this initiative, working full-time in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This position requires 8-10 years of experience. Role Context and Objectives The Core Technical Lead will contribute to building solutions for complex problems within the Core Network. This role involves joining a team focused on innovation and continuous improvement, aiming to define and implement architectural standards and automation initiatives. The position requires a professional who can lead technical aspects and ensure robust change management processes. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of solution architects and integrators. Analyze service requirements, High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and Service Design Packages. Assess cross-domain impact across CS Core, IMS, and PS Core. Define the end-to-end implementation architecture and deployment strategy. Lead technical risk, impact, rollback, and dependency assessments. Define testing, validation, KPI monitoring, and acceptance criteria. Review and approve Methods of Procedure (MOPs), scripts, implementation plans, and change packages. Act as a technical authority during Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews and major implementations. Support root cause analysis and post-implementation reviews. Drive architectural standards, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of experience in telecom Core Networks. Experience with HLD/LLD analysis, impact analysis, migrations, upgrades, and network transformations. Experience working with change management, CAB governance, and operational handovers. Required Skills Strong stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated technical leadership abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a team focused on innovation and technical governance in Managed Services.

3c8cdb3047482a04.description: نبحث عن أخصائي تسويق مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات تسويقية مبتكرة. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إدارة حملاتنا التسويقية الرقمية والتقليدية، وتحليل أداء الحملات، وتقديم تقارير دورية. نهدف إلى تعزيز علامتنا التجارية وزيادة الوعي بها من خلال خطط تسويقية فعالة. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تطوير وتنفيذ خطط تسويقية شاملة تتوافق مع أهداف الشركة. * إدارة وتحسين حملات التسويق الرقمي عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، محركات البحث، والبريد الإلكتروني. * تحليل بيانات السوق والمنافسين لتحديد الفرص والتحديات. * إنشاء محتوى تسويقي جذاب ومقنع لجميع المنصات. *عمل قياس وتحليل أداء الحملات التسويقية وتقديم تقارير مفصلة.

3cbabf745817d6d5.description: About the Role ACWA Power is seeking an experienced ARCS Engineer for upcoming full-time opportunities within Solar PV plants in Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for providing specialized engineering support for Automatic Robotic Cleaning Systems (ARCS), automation, and associated electrical and control equipment. The primary objective is to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of solar panel cleaning systems. Key Responsibilities Plan and implement preventive and predictive maintenance activities for robotic cleaning systems and associated automation equipment. Troubleshoot and maintain robotic cleaning equipment, including motors, drives, sensors, control panels, and electrical systems. Diagnose faults in PLC-based controls, control circuits, and industrial communication systems. Conduct root-cause analysis of electrical, automation, and robotics failures, and implement reliability improvements. Support testing, commissioning, and functional verification of new or modified robotic cleaning equipment. Coordinate technical issues, warranty claims, and maintenance interventions with OEMs and specialist suppliers. Maintain technical documentation, equipment configurations, maintenance records, and fault reports. Provide technical guidance and support to maintenance technicians. Ensure compliance with HSSE requirements, permit-to-work procedures, equipment isolation, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) standards. Experience Required Candidates should possess between 7 to 10 years of relevant experience. Work Conditions This is a plant-based position located at Solar PV facilities within Saudi Arabia.

3ce72ce103652206.description: About the Role SANS is seeking a Digital Network Lead to deliver and operate secure, resilient, and high-performance network and CCTV infrastructure. This full-time role is essential for enabling reliable user and application connectivity across both on-premises and cloud environments within SANS. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to ensure continuous availability, security, and compliance of network infrastructure. This involves proactive monitoring, automation, incident resolution, and maintaining audit readiness. Additionally, the role is responsible for integrated video surveillance systems, supporting operational continuity, privacy, and organizational safety requirements. Key Responsibilities Deliver and operate secure, resilient, and high-performance network infrastructure. Manage and maintain CCTV infrastructure to support organizational safety and operational continuity. Ensure reliable user and application connectivity across on-premises and cloud environments. Implement proactive monitoring and automation strategies for network and CCTV systems. Resolve incidents efficiently to minimize downtime and maintain system availability. Ensure compliance with security standards and prepare for audits. Maintain integrated video surveillance systems, adhering to privacy and safety requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated understanding of network infrastructure principles. Familiarity with CCTV systems and their operational requirements. Work Type This is a full-time position within SANS. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Digital Network Lead position at SANS.

3cebd26997db8dda.description: Lead the commercial management and strategic oversight of district cooling programs, ensuring effective contract management, procurement governance, commercial performance, and value optimization across development and operational phases. Provide commercial leadership for district cooling infrastructure investments, concession arrangements, service agreements, and stakeholder partnerships to support business objectives and long-term sustainability. Drive commercial excellence through robust governance, risk management, financial oversight, and strategic decision-making related to district cooling assets and services. Section III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACCOUNTABILITIES Key Responsibilities • Lead commercial activities related to district cooling projects, infrastructure programs, and operational service agreements. • Develop and implement commercial strategies to support district cooling development, expansion, and operational objectives. • Oversee commercial evaluations, procurement strategies, tendering activities, and contract award recommendations. • Manage commercial negotiations with district cooling operators, utility providers, contractors, consultants, and strategic partners. • Lead the preparation and review of commercial agreements, concession arrangements, service contracts, and partnership frameworks. • Monitor commercial performance, contractual obligations, revenue mechanisms, cost structures, and financial commitments. • Oversee contract administration, variation management, claims resolution, and dispute management activities. • Collaborate with Development, Engineering, Utilities, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure alignment of commercial objectives. • Assess commercial risks and opportunities and implement mitigation and value-enhancement strategies. • Support business case development, investment evaluations, tariff assessments, and commercial feasibility studies. • Ensure compliance with governance requirements, commercial policies, regulatory obligations, and contractual commitments. • Lead and develop commercial teams while promoting continuous improvement and best practices. Section IV: KEY INTERACTIONS Key Internal Interactions • Utilities Leadership • Development Teams • Engineering Teams • Operations Teams • Finance and Development Finance Teams • Procurement Department • Legal Department • Risk Management Functions • Executive Leadership Key External Interactions • District Cooling Operators • Utility Providers • Contractors • Consultants • Government Authorities • Regulatory Bodies • Investors and Strategic Partners • External Advisors Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. • Master's degree preferred. Professional Certifications • MRICS, FRICS, PMP, CCM, MBA, or equivalent professional certification preferred. Skills • Commercial management • Utility and infrastructure commercial management • Contract administration • Procurement and sourcing strategy • Financial and commercial analysis • Negotiation and stakeholder management • Commercial risk management • Claims and dispute resolution • Strategic planning • Leadership and team development Experience Years of Experience • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in commercial management, utilities, district cooling, infrastructure development, energy, construction, or related disciplines. Nature of Experience • Managing commercial activities for district cooling, utilities, infrastructure, or major capital projects. • Negotiating and administering complex commercial agreements and service contracts. • Supporting utility infrastructure development, concession models, and operational service arrangements. • Leading multidisciplinary commercial teams and stakeholder engagement activities. • Delivering commercial governance, value optimization, and risk management initiatives within large-scale development environments.

3c25726cd4242573.description: About Dar Jana International Schools Dar Jana International Schools is seeking a Kindergarten Academic Coordinator to join their team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with opportunities available in both Jeddah and Makkah. Role Overview The Kindergarten Academic Coordinator provides leadership, oversight, and support for all academic affairs within the preschool department. This role is central to ensuring the quality and effectiveness of instructional programs and curriculum development. Key Responsibilities Supervising, coaching, and evaluating teachers within the preschool department. Developing and refining the curriculum, ensuring alignment with the PYP framework. Utilizing data to measure the effectiveness of instructional programs and inform improvements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Demonstrated leadership capabilities in academic coordination or a similar role. Work Environment and Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with the company operating in both Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within an educational setting focused on early childhood development. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3cddf4d11b0b78c3.description: About Invygo Invygo is focused on transforming the car leasing experience. As a Senior Social Media Specialist, you will be instrumental in expanding Invygo's presence across Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Senior Social Media Specialist will manage Invygo's social media presence, develop a consistent brand voice, and convert content engagement into customer growth. The role involves creating, shooting, editing, and publishing content across platforms such as TikTok, Snapchat, and Instagram to foster connections with the audience in the Kingdom. This position is part of a collaborative team where contributions directly influence Invygo's success, focusing on data-driven insights to optimize performance. Key Responsibilities Manage Invygo's social media presence in KSA, prioritizing an Arabic-first voice in Saudi dialect and an English lane for the expat audience. Concept, shoot, edit, write, and publish daily short-form video content across TikTok, Snapchat, and Instagram. Appear on camera as the face of Invygo KSA content, including explainers, street formats, and product walk-throughs. Develop and manage the KSA content calendar around key Saudi events such as Ramadan, Eid, Founding Day, Saudi National Day, and Riyadh Season. Create native content for each platform rather than repurposing identical content across all channels. Content and Brand Development Localize Invygo's brand content series and develop new Saudi-native formats that resonate with the local audience. Build content formats that respect local privacy norms and cultural nuances. Ensure all captions, scripts, and briefs are accurate and align with product and legal guidelines. Engage with the community through comments, DMs, and replies, and route service issues to the CX team promptly. Performance and Collaboration Collaborate with the influencer agency and creator roster across Riyadh and Jeddah to brief, direct, and review creator content. Identify top-performing content and recommend it for paid amplification (TikTok Spark Ads, Snapchat). Track and optimize the organic funnel from content to app installs, focusing on qualified traffic. Analyze content performance and trends to inform future content decisions. Work with the shared production team (video, design, motion, and Arabic copy) to deliver high-quality content. Collaborate with the UAE social team on a shared content calendar. Represent KSA in cross-market planning and share monthly learnings with the wider marketing team.

3c2dcfcc1705bd79.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول الميدانية للتجارة عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على توفير خدمة نقل آمنة وموثوقة للركاب، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والصيانة الدورية للمركبة. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة والتبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير طارئ. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب المخالفات النظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة للسيارة لمعالجة أي مشكلات بسيطة قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب تدخل الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل أثناء القيادة. التقيد التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال قيادة السيارات. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. المهارات الشخصية القدرة على الالتزام بالمواعيد بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة. القدرة على التعامل مع المشكلات الطارئة بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في المدينة المنورة. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بالجدول الزمني المحدد لضمان نقل الركاب بكفاءة وأمان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3c9b15e7c03f45dc.description: About the Role Dar wa Emaar is seeking a Purchasing Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves developing and implementing procurement strategies to support project requirements and corporate objectives, while ensuring cost efficiency and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement procurement strategies to meet project requirements efficiently and minimize costs. Conduct strategic analysis of the supplier market and competitors to identify and select suitable suppliers. Execute efficient and effective procurement operations for necessary materials and services. Negotiate with suppliers to secure optimal deals, commercial terms, and competitive prices, ensuring timely delivery. Monitor the quality of purchased materials and services to ensure compliance with required standards. Estimate project needs for materials and services and identify appropriate suppliers to fulfill these requirements. Build and cultivate long-term relationships with preferred suppliers. Monitor and regularly evaluate supplier performance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or procurement engineering. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement procurement strategies. Strong negotiation skills and experience in supplier relationship management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a professional and collaborative work environment at Dar wa Emaar.

3ca294f94ca51d0c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بدقة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح لضمان دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقًا للخطط المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف والمواد اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزامًا بجدول زمني منتظم لضمان استمرارية عمليات الصيانة. عن شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات تلتزم شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مجالها، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها التشغيلية والحفاظ على معايير الأداء المتميزة. التقديم نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذا الدور.

3cbcc65b057e4319.job_title: Lead Product Service Engineer Controls Platform HMI & Network
3cbcc65b057e4319.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Lead Product Service Engineer for Controls Platform HMI & Network to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on enhancing service technology by analyzing customer data and evaluating the reliability, availability, maintenance, security, and overall performance of engines and products. The position involves both planning and executing departmental operations, with a focus on professional activities within a technical discipline. The role offers autonomy, guided by established policies and a review of end results, allowing for adjustments in workflows and practices to meet quality, scope, and timeliness standards. Key Responsibilities Support the installed base by resolving customer issues, addressing fleet problems, implementing service bulletins, and conducting monitoring and diagnosis. Manage fleet configuration, maintain fleet data, and oversee outage management. Utilize in-depth technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and technical experience to implement policies and strategies.
